native.operation: Clamp value to [0,1], quantize to an 8-bit value, clear byte ((type - 8) & 31) in the packed word, OR the quantized value shifted to that byte, then reinterpret the uint bits as float.

producer_audit.conclusion: The source-backed producer for the character custom per-draw channel is recovered (CHARACTER_PARAMS_INDEX=2), while the final channel-2-to-cb3[0].w binding remains open. Do not synthesize a packed word from _ShadingModel, UnityPerDraw, channel 2, or zero/default values. Keep Target2.w and Target3.w neutral until the binding-compatible upload or an authorized target-frame capture is recovered.
